name: markstream-vue
title_zh: 把 Markdown 流式渲染器装进 Vue 3 项
tagline_zh: AI 长回复在 Vue 3 里逐字蹦出，光标不抖、代码块不闪。内置虚拟时间轴，千行流式输出也稳如本地渲染。
tagline_en: Stream AI markdown into Vue 3 without cursor jitter or code flash. Built-in virtual timeline keeps 1000-line.
desc_en: Integrate markstream-vue into a Vue 3 app. Use when Codex needs to add the Vue 3 renderer, import CSS in the right order, choose renderer and DOM modes, choose built-in, plain, or custom code-block paths, choose between `content` and `nodes`, coordinate long AI timelines with `MarkstreamVirtualTimeline`, `useMarkstreamVirtualAdapter`, or `vue-virtual-scroller`, enable optional peers such as stream
why_zh: 它把渲染器拆成可插拔路径，并用虚拟时间轴对齐 AI 的异步输出——不是简单 v-html。
why_en: Pluggable renderer paths plus a virtual timeline that paces async AI output—not a v-html hack, but rhythmic, recyclable.
limit_zh: 只服务 Vue 3 + 浏览器 DOM；不处理 Markdown 解析本身，需自带或另配 markdown-it。
limit_en: Vue 3 + DOM only; no markdown parsing included—pair with markdown-it. Virtual scrolling needs vue-virtual-scroller, else long-list perf is not.
